Copper-alloy Roman Nummus dating to the 4 th century AD c. 348-364 AD. Reece period 18. Likely FEL TEMP REPARATIO reverse type. Obverse is diademed bust right. Inscription illegible. Reverse is emperor standing left on galley with standard, Victory behind
